source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 360 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 360 was established by Ordinance No. 21146, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 11, 1991. Ordinance No. 21146 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 21146 was amended by Ordinance No. 22327, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 8, 1995. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 21146; 22327; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 360 is established on property generally located along the north line of Keller Springs Road, east of the most southeasterly end of a corner clip at the northeast corner of Keller Springs Road and the North Dallas Tollway. The size of PD 360 is approximately 5.345 acres. (Ord. Nos. 21146; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 21146; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 360A). (Ord. Nos. 21146; 22327; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.105. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property is multifamily. (Ord. Nos. 21146; 25850)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.106. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

Except as otherwise provided, development of the Property must comply with the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MF-1(A) Multifamily District contained in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 22327; 25850)

sections.title: Density
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.107. DENSITY.

The ratio of dwelling units to lot area must average 23.9 units per net acre. The total number of dwelling units located on the Property must not exceed 128. (Ord. Nos. 21146; 25850)

sections.title: Elevation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.108. ELEVATION.

Development of the Property must comply with the elevation (Exhibit 360B). (Ord. Nos. 21146; 25850)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.109. LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage is 31 percent. Carports are not included in lot coverage calculations. (Ord. Nos. 21146; 25850)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.110. HEIGHT.

Unless further restricted by the development plan, maximum structure height is 38 feet. (Ord. Nos. 22327; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.111. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Parking must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 21146; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.112. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 21146; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.113. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21146; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.114. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 22327; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22327; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-360.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 360 is located on Zoning Map No. B-7. (Ord. Nos. 21146; 25850)
